content: KDE System Settings categories: Hardware (keyboard/mouse/touchpad/tablet), Network (cmst/nm), Applications (startup), Workspace, Display & Monitor, Color Management, Input Devices, Shortcuts, Window Management, Notifications, Online Accounts, Bluetooth, Printers, Regional & Language, Power Management, KDE Wallet, Themes/Look-and-Feel, Screensaver. Broader than GNOME; much of it (color mgmt, tablets, a11y, printers) is DE-scale scope Archel should NOT chase.
